name: subscription-stripe
description: A subscription provider on Stripe through stripe and @better-auth/stripe; needs a Stripe account.

envVars.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY: Your Stripe secret key (sk_test_… while you develop, sk_live_… in production). Required once SUBSCRIPTION_PROVIDER=stripe. The client is built on first use, so a project that keeps SUBSCRIPTION_PROVIDER=console runs the whole capability — sign-in included — with this unset; the throw then names the key on the first call that reaches Stripe.
envVars.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET: The signing secret of the endpoint you registered at https://dashboard.stripe.com/webhooks, pointing at https://<your-api>/auth/stripe/webhook. The plugin verifies every delivery against it, so an unsigned POST is refused before any handler runs.

removeWarnings: Removing this module does not cancel anything at Stripe. Cancel live subscriptions in the Stripe dashboard first, and delete the webhook endpoint you registered.
`stripe` and `@better-auth/stripe` stay in packages/subscription/package.json. Uninstalling an npm dependency is yours to do; run `pnpm remove` in that workspace when nothing else needs them.
